messages:
Jenna Park: FYI — external assessor scheduled for Wed 09:00 PT. We need: (1) ephemeral assessor role ARN (timeboxed), (2) an evidence manifest format + signing workflow, (3) a short RBAC toggle plan we can flip for scoped reads. Who can take the tracker?
Omar Singh: I can do the tracker and owners. Scope the RBAC to only the artifact-read SA + read-only metadata. No write perms.
Priya Nair: Agree on least privilege. For KMS, prefer GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + Encrypt/Decrypt blocked — assessor should never get raw DEK.
Marcus Li: SGTM. Also require aws:RequestTag/assessment=ext-pt and aws:PrincipalTag/role=assessor in the policy. Timebox 6h max.
Alejandra Gomez: I'll provision a presigned multipart upload endpoint and an evidence prefix: s3://pt-evidence/ext-202408/. Lifecycle 120d. Will give upload creds to readroom only.
Jenna Park: For the manifest, let's use newline-delimited JSON with fields: filename, sha256, timestamp, signer. Prefer in-toto attestation or a simple TUF-signed manifest?
Omar Singh: in-toto would be great but heavy. Proposal: manifest.ndjson signed by EvidenceBot's KMS signing key (asymmetric) plus an in-toto style predicate. That satisfies compliance without full TUF.
EvidenceBot: created signing key pair: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/sign-key-2024. Will only expose Verify endpoint.
Priya Nair: Important: KMS key must have Deny on ScheduleKeyDeletion and not allow GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext from service accounts that are not tagged.
Marcus Li: RBAC toggle plan: feature-flag route /pt-mode. Default off. Canary in staging, then flip flag for the assessor's session only. Return 403 if not authorized. Rollback is flip flag off.
Alejandra Gomez: Presigned upload endpoints created. I'll post URLs in the readroom 1hr before the window. Multipart required for >5MB.
Jenna Park: Audit requirements: we need CloudTrail, OS auth logs, and k8s-audit for the sim window + 24h prior. Can we export as gzipped ndjson?
InfraBot: audit-export job queued: job id ae-1746009999-1. Outputs will be cloudtrail-1746009999.gz, k8s-audit-1746009999.ndjson.gz, sysauth-1746009999.gz. Presigns valid 72h.
Omar Singh: Remediation tracker created: https://internal.redwood/sec/remediation/pt-ext-1746009999 (owners + tickets). I'll add a column for evidence manifest and assessor ARN.
Priya Nair: Triage note: outstanding medium issues — kube-admission patching, service-account privilege drift, and public S3 ACLs. Need fix+verify before we hand to assessor.
Marcus Li: For verification, add a small smoke eval that validates k8s admission behavior and checks for unauthorized SA actions. Put results into manifest too.
Alejandra Gomez: Evidence upload workflow: (1) run verify script -> produces files, (2) EvidenceBot signs manifest, (3) upload to presigned prefix, (4) push manifest URL to readroom.
EvidenceBot: verification script template uploaded: /internal/tools/pt/verify.sh. It outputs manifest.ndjson and signature.sig.
Jenna Park: Compliance asks that the assessor role ARN and the signature key id are recorded in the evidence pack. Add both to the tracker evidence tab.
Omar Singh: Will add. Also scheduling two retest windows Thu 08:00-10:00 PT and Fri 14:00-16:00 PT in case fixes need validation. Calendar invites incoming.
Priya Nair: One more policy snippet suggestion for KMS: use condition StringEquals: aws:RequestTag/assessment=pt-ext and Bool: aws:ViaAWSService=false so no cross-service misuse.
Marcus Li: Also plan an automated RBAC rollback: if more than 5% 5xx/errors during canary, flip off immediately. Metrics from the feature-flag exporter.
Alejandra Gomez: I'll capture sha256 sums and attach them as signed lines in the manifest. Will also record object etags for multipart.
InfraBot: audit-exporter finished: presigns posted to readroom, valid until 2024-08-18T09:00:00Z.
Jenna Park: Great. Final checklist for pre-sim dry run 24h prior: (a) tracker owners confirmed, (b) presigned upload posted, (c) EvidenceBot signing key verified, (d) RBAC toggle tested in canary.
Omar Singh: Tracker link posted and owners pinged.
Alejandra Gomez: Presign test succeeded.
EvidenceBot: Signing key verify OK.
Priya Nair: I'll run the pre-sim verification and post results to tracker.
Jenna Park: Thanks all. We'll converge in #incidents 1hr before the sim for final handoff. :white_check_mark:
